acceptance_checks.detail: Original AutoSci native /check skill document exists.
Original AutoSci wiki lint tool exists as the native structural check reference.
Solar feature parity route binds /check to check_wiki_health under cap.research-workflow-evolve.
Solar check_wiki_health executed tools/lint.py --wiki-root and archived autosci_wiki_lint_cli.v1 output with zero error issues.
The local proof run produced workflow evidence and recommendations without applying wiki or raw-source mutations.
Final quality readiness required and received completed model-command evidence with persisted request/response provenance and evidence ids.
Targeted $check regression coverage asserts native lint artifact emission, final quality readiness, model provenance hashes, and runtime proof category boundaries.

findings.finding: The check route is semantically full for report-only wiki health checks when explicit model/reviewer quality evidence is supplied.
Side-effecting --fix behavior remains outside this semantic-full claim because the Solar route is report-only by default and side_effect_policy is none.

The current local proof uses an absolute --wiki-root and an internally quoted --model-command because relative harness-prefixed roots and unquoted paths containing spaces can fall back or split incorrectly.

limitations: LLM-assisted content quality checks can be backed by explicit model evidence or a model command with persisted request/response provenance; check_final_quality_boundary requires passing local wiki checks plus completed model-backed recommendation evidence, and absent model evidence is not treated as deterministic pass/fail.

summary: Solar $check preserves the native report-only wiki health check path, executes native lint semantics through tools/lint.py --wiki-root, surfaces structural findings as gate evidence, and requires completed model/reviewer evidence before final quality readiness.
